newsitem.title: UK: ABF says strong pound to hit full yr results.
newsitem.headline: ABF says strong pound to hit full yr results.

text.p: British foods group Associated British Foods Plc said on Monday it expected satisfactory results from its operating companies but warned that the strong pound would affect full year results.

"Results will continue to be affected by the strength of sterling, particularly the impact of the green pound, but nevertheless we anticipate a satisfactory trading performance from our operating companies," the company said in a statement.
ABF said the strong pound had wiped around 11 million stg from its half-year profits. In the first half, earnings before tax totalled 201 million stg, up from 198 million a year earlier.
